par2cmdline-turbo v1.4.0 (https://github.com/animetosho/par2cmdline-turbo, tag v1.4.0)
Vendored: src/, parpar/gf16/, parpar/hasher/, parpar/src/, COPYING.
CLI-only and OpenCL files are excluded from the build in Package.swift, not deleted.

LOCAL PATCHES (re-apply ALL of these when bumping the vendored version — every site is
marked with "MODERNPAR PATCH" in the source):

1. src/foreach_parallel.h — worker-thread exceptions are captured and rethrown on the
   calling thread instead of hitting std::terminate (bare std::thread path) or being
   silently swallowed (std::async wait() path); thread-creation failure mid-spawn joins
   already-started workers before rethrowing. Required for Par2Shim's cooperative
   cancellation, which throws from the output streambuf on engine threads.

2. parpar/gf16/threadqueue.h — MessageThread gains join() (wait for the thread to drain
   its queue and exit after end()).

3. parpar/gf16/controller_cpu.cpp — PAR2ProcCPU::_deinit() quiesces in dependency order
   (transferThread first — it submits compute work — then thWorkers) and JOINS everything
   before freeGf(). Resolves upstream's "TODO: join threads?". Without this, deinit during
   a cancellation unwind frees the GF context / staging buffers while kernels are still
   running them (use-after-free, SIGSEGV reproduced).

4. src/par2repairer.cpp + src/par2creator.cpp — destructors call parpar.deinit() BEFORE
   delete[] transferbuffer (workers read/write that buffer; with patch 3's joining deinit
   this ordering makes exception unwinds safe).

Success-path behavior is unchanged by all patches.
